validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 QEMU C6 guest 内通过 135x240 显示、触摸/按键、PI4IOE、BQ27220/AW32001、BMI270、SX1262 LoRa、RMT 红外、I2S 蜂鸣器、QEMU ESP32-C6 WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 UART1 HCI BLE NUS；独立 runner 与 Device Service 单个 qemu-unified lease 均通过，stock hardware.RGB() 仍为 NOT RUN。RUNTIME-01 已定位为 16 MiB Flash legacy 写擦地址宽度和复位 PMP 状态问题并修复：Meshtastic 经 Device Service 重跑不再报 Invalid chip id，但仍存在独立的 Instruction access fault，因此完整功能仍为 PARTIAL。

官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 QEMU C6 guest 内通过 hardware.RGB/WS2812、GPIO9 按键、GPIO7 蓝色 LED、RMT NEC 红外、QEMU ESP32-C6 WiFi 扫描/关联/DHCP/HTTP 和 UART1 HCI BLE NUS；独立 runner、公网探针和 Device Service 单个 qemu-unified lease 均通过。跨厂商公开固件审查另记录 Zigbee/802.15.4 controller 未建模（RUNTIME-02）；这不否定已通过的基线外设/WiFi/BLE 路径。

validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 4/4 each (8/8 total), two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 3/3 each (6/6 total), and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 4/4 each (8/8 total). Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle, so QEMU can fill those guest objects without nested guest calls when CPU0 is busy. The initial four-instance gate then failed 1/4 after the 2/2 reserve was exhausted by the startup burst; attempt 2 had hli-errors=1 and hli-prealloc-failures=2, while attempts 3/4 panicked in NimBLE ble_hs_hci_process_ack after HCI ACK timeout/reset. Patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event and 4 ACL objects; both independent four-instance reruns then pass. Every passing lease records all 36 events and 9 ACLs on the fast path, ends with 8/4 spare depth, HLI 45/45, hli-errors=0 and no scheduler reset or panic. One first-batch lease records two transient refill failures before recovery; the confirmation batch records none. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches with a 30-second startup stagger pass 5/5 each (10/10 total) with maximum concurrency 5. A zero-stagger five-instance gate is unstable: one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5 on the same firmware/ELF/QEMU/tool hashes, exposing the same NimBLE ACK panic or an external GATT exchange failure. More than five instances, zero-stagger five-instance cold start, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 m5core2 guest 内通过 320x240 显示/触摸、AXP2101、INA3221、MPU6886、PCF8563、NS4168 扬声器、SPM1423 麦克风、OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 stock firmware 外部 BLE GATT；确定性 TCG/icount 调度下 10/10 次无重试首轮启动通过，QOM 注入不暂停 guest。规范 Device Service profile `core2-native-hci` 在五个独立 lease 中通过 HCI-4：frame、27 节点 QOM、WiFi/公网、外部 NUS GATT、pcap 和 evidence 同包，且 gdb_bridge=false。m5core2 machine 现以 8 MiB PSRAM device 和 DRAM1 32 KiB MMU 页映射运行；三个独立 esp_himem lease 在同一个虚拟窗口切换两个不同物理块并反向校验，QOM 8 MiB，正常 heap 仍为架构允许的 4 MiB 直接映射窗口。0005 恢复 nested guest call 的 caller-saved sregs，并把 HLI allocator/callback 注入限制在 halted/idle vCPU；两批独立 5×10 秒运行合计 10/10，3 个 60 秒 hold 为 3/3，2 个 120 秒 hold 为 2/2，另 2 个 active-BLE 600 秒 hold 为 2/2。3 个独立 lease 分别完成 20、30、60、120 轮 scan/connect/NUS GATT/disconnect；当前参数上限为 121 并拒绝 122。一百二十轮每 lease HLI 3377/3377、events 2297、ACLs 1080，HLI/meta/TX queue、错误和 panic 均为 0，连接/L2CAP/GATT 池回到 3/9/3，三次 frame SHA256 一致。600 秒 active-BLE hold 时 peer 未关闭，HLI 45/45，队列与错误为 0。另一次 7200 秒 active-BLE WiFi/公网/GATT 保持由 hash-freeze runner 完成 artifact-bound 功能门禁：首 lease 前绑定 firmware/ELF/QEMU，运行期无资产漂移，frame/pcap/网络/GATT/HLI health 均 PASS，结束 HLI 45/45 且队列、错误和 peer-close 为 0。QEMU host RSS 从 744160 KiB 增至 1202176 KiB；后续 vmmap 把增长定位到未限容的 TCG translation buffer，`tb-size=128` 的 120 秒复测稳定，最终两小时限容复测 PASS：RSS 323536→252992 KiB、phys footprint 250880→188416 KiB，资产与工具哈希无漂移。旧 `core2-native-vhci` 的 repeated lease 为 1/2，仅保留为 GDB 诊断/兼容路径。121 轮第一次运行完成 29 轮后暴露固定 180 秒 readiness 预算缺陷；第二次完成 121/121 后又暴露 reconnect-only accelerator 采样缺失。两处 harness 问题修复后，3 个独立 lease 均完成 121/121 artifact-bound PASS：bounded_tcg_cache、WiFi/公网、NUS GATT、frame/QOM、pcap、evidence 和 cleanup 均通过，每 lease HLI 3405/3405、events 2316、ACLs 1089，队列、错误、dropped、peer-close 和 panic 均为 0。随后 3 个连续 ready session 在 HTTP/BLE companion 仍活跃、BLE peer 仍处于 linger 时被 DELETE；每次 stop 均为 stopped/无错误，companion 进入 terminated，BLE/QEMU PID 回收，worker lease 归零，下一 session 继续通过 frame/QOM、DHCP/DNS/HTTP、外部 NUS GATT、pcap 和 evidence。四实例首批 4×120s 先达到并发 4 但为 1 PASS / 3 FAIL：一个 lease 完成可见功能但仍有 hli-errors=1 与 hli-prealloc-failures=2；另两个在 READY 前于 NimBLE ble_hs_hci_process_ack 的 0x402630cc 处 panic。Bumble peer 实际返回 Command Complete，根因收敛为 0008 的 2/2 备用对象被四条并发启动 burst 耗尽。0009 将真实 guest 备用池扩为 8 event/4 ACL 后，两批独立四实例 4×120s 均 4/4 PASS，合计 8/8；QOM depth 8/4、HLI 45/45、36 events/9 ACLs、errors/reset/panic 均为 0。首批一个 lease 保留 2 次 transient refill failure，确认批为 0。五实例 30 秒错峰又完成两批 5×120s，合计 10/10；相同实现的零错峰五实例一批 5/5 PASS、独立确认批 3/5 FAIL，因此零错峰同时冷启动仍不稳定。物理 cache/PSRAM、零错峰五实例与更多实例、长时并发/吞吐、其他 teardown 模式与 Espressif BT baseband/controller bit-exact 执行仍未完成。

validation.detail: UIFlow2 P4 firmware boots with the C6 ESP-Hosted bridge, renders a physical 1280x720 landscape frame through the real M5GFX drawing path, and redraws after touch. Tab5 I2C reaches G31/G32 through the P4 controller: INA226 preload reaches Power as 8000mV/1248mA/87%, machine.RTC writes and reads RX8130, both PI4IOE IDs/output writeback pass, and CHG_STAT=0x00/0x40 reaches Power.isCharging() as charging/discharging. SIT3088 RS-485 passes through UART1 G20/G21 and direction G34. BMI270 identity, dynamic I2C/time injection, IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and the remaining native P4 data planes remain partial.

validation.detail: 官方 CardputerZero ARM64 镜像以 512 MiB RAM 启动；ST7789v3 的 DRM/fb1 路径输出 320x170 RGB565 帧，QMP TCA8418 事件经 BCM GPIO27 中断进入 Linux input。TCA8418、M5IOE1、BMI270、BMM150、RX8130、BQ27220 和 ES8389 均绑定到 Linux 驱动；ES8389 I2C ID/状态、ALSA 播放 PCM、麦克风 PCM 逐字节回放和 AW8737A GPIO24 使能通过；IP2315 QOM 电源路径注入使 BQ27220/Linux status 从 Charging 切换为 Discharging；GL852G MTT 兼容路径同时完成 SR9900A Full-Speed 以太网帧回环和 Low-Speed HID 枚举/输入，r8152 创建 eth0；QMP GPIO13 波形经 Linux LIRC 收到 mode2 数据，GPIO12 NEC 发送边沿可抓取；IMX219 寄存器驱动 Unicam CSI1 完成 640x480 RG10 V4L2 实帧与 V4L2 控制项验证；官方 factory_test 的 LVGL 320x170 首帧通过 fb1 验证，54400/54400 个像素非黑、127 种 RGB565 颜色，画面哈希在 UI 启动后发生变化。
